arabic text: LUTI KIN FIZAON MAY AALE PAYAMBAR\nNA MAI KEH SAKOONGA NA TUM SUN SAKOGE
english translation text: IN WHAT SURROUNDINGS WAS THE PROGENY OF THE PROPHET DESTROYED?\nNEITHER CAN I DESCRIBE, NOR CAN YOU HEAR

arabic text: HUA KAISE KHAALI ALI KA BHARA GHAR\nNA MAI KEH SAKOONGA NA TUM SUN SAKOGE
english translation text: HOW WAS ALI’S BUSTLING HOME EMPTIED?\nNEITHER CAN I DESCRIBE, NOR CAN YOU HEAR

arabic text: LAGI DIL PE BARCHI JIGAR MOO KO AAYA\nSADA AAYI MAQTAL SE BABA KAHAN HO\nCHALE KIS KA LAASHA UTHANE KO SARWAR
english translation text: A LANCE PIERCED HIS HEART, HE WRITHED AGONY\nA VOICE AROSE FROM THE SLAUGHTERING FIELDS, FATHER WHERE ARE YOU?\nWHOSE CORPSE HAS SARWAR GONE TO RETRIEVE?

arabic text: NA MAI KEH SAKOONGA NA TUM SUN SAKOGE
english translation text: NEITHER CAN I DESCRIBE, NOR CAN YOU HEAR

arabic text: BADA SHIMR KHANJAR LIYE KISKI JAANIB\nPUKAARA THA MAQTAL SE KIS NE ALI KO\nNAZAR AAYA SAR KISKA NOKE SINA PAR
english translation text: TOWARDS WHOM DID SHIMR ADVANCE WITH A DAGGER?\nWHO HAD CALLED UPON ALI FROM THE SLAUGHTERING FIELDS?\nWHOSE HEAD WAS SEEN ON THE POINT OF A SPEAR?

arabic text: WO KHOONKHAR SEHRA WO WEHSHI HAWAEIN\nWO SUNSAAN JANGAL WO MAA KI SADAYEIN\nKAHAN SOGAYE JAAKE JHOOLE SE ASGHAR
english translation text: THAT BLOODIED DESERT, THOSE BESTIAL WINDS\nTHAT EERIE WILDERNESS, AND THE MOTHER’S CALLING\nWHERE HAVE YOU FALLEN ASLEEP, ASGHAR?

arabic text: KAHOON UMME LAILA KA MAI HAAL KAISE\nBAYAN KYA HO KULSOOM KI BEBASI KA\nUTAARI GAYI KAISE ZAINAB KI CHADAR
english translation text: HOW CAN I DESCRIBE THE STATE OF UMM-E-LAILA?\nWHAT CAN BE SAID ABOUT THE HELPLESSNESS OF KULTHOOM?\nHOW WAS ZAINAB’S VEIL SNATCHED

arabic text: SATAYA THA GHURBAT MAY KISKO SHAKI NE\nKAHOO JAISE RUQSAAR THAY KISKE ZAKHMI\nTAMACHAY LAGATA THA KISKO SITAMGAR
english translation text: WHO HAD THE WRETCH BULLIED IN A FOREIGN LAND?\nHOW CAN I SAY, WHOSE CHEEKS WERE WOUNDED\nWHO WAS THE CRUEL BARBARIAN SLAPPING?

arabic text: VIQAR AAH KIS DIL SE AB MAI BATAUN\nJO GUZRI HAI ZAINAB KE QALBE AZEEN PAR\nWO BAZAAR O DARBARE KOOFE KA MANZAR
english translation text: O WAQAR, WITH WHAT HEART CAN I NOW NARRATE?\nWHAT BEFELL THE UPON SORROWFUL HEART OF ZAINAB\nTHAT SIGHT OF THE BAZAR AND THE COURT OF KUFA
